nings

ux of spiritual

eding from

ive principle through

 forth into form

 perception

 degree
 of

 truth
 of
 the celest
ial kingdom

most
 things
 of

eding from the Divine Love
 itself

rence, is the in
most aff
ection for wisdom

 the
 sake of truth —

alted.

**¶5
:** The origin of all power
 to
 persu
ade the

 aff
ections and

 the prim
ordial celest
ial state — the first spiritual vol
ition given

 humanity

**¶6:** The
 origin of all capacity
 for spiritual combat against
 fals
ity and evil is the Divine Proce
eding that animates the regener
ating
 will

-giving principle that has

 faculties of

most to the out
most.

 The origin of all power
 to form
 doctrine
 and to construct the interior
 framework
 of the spiritual mind is the Divine
 Intelligence
 that
 orders
 all
 tru
ths into
 their
 heav
enly form

 and
 chief
 of all capac
ities for sust
aining the weight

 infl
ux is the central
 axis of Divine
 Truth itself
 — the supporting
 column

 that
 is above
 flows
 into
 all
 that is below.

**¶
9:** The origin of all liberation
 from falsity and bond
age to
 evil is Divine
 Truth made
 manifest in
 full
ness;
 the red
eeming principle that f
rees every
 faculty
 that
 belongs
 to the interior
 man
 through
 the power
 of tru
ths received
 and
 understood

**¶10:** The
 origin of every
 interior
 perception
 of genuine
 truth
 is the pure
 affection for wisdom unc
orrupted by any
 self
-derived
 falsity — the virg
inal love of truth in
 its
 own
 light
.

**¶11:** The
 origin of all illumin
ation in
 those
 who receive
 the highest
 goods
 is the Divine
 Rational
 itself
 desc
ending into the human
 mind —
 that
 which
 r
ouses
 the
 understanding
 from
 its sleep of
 ignorance and g
athers into
 unity

 the
 goods
 and
 truths that have
 been dispers
ed and
 frag
mented throughout

sordered natural
 mind.
